description: Finish and optionally promote a manual memory session you explicitly own. Never call this for a hook-owned session: when verified lifecycle hooks are active they finalize it themselves, and finishing it here closes a session out from under them.

promote.description: Whether to promote the session's captures into project memory. Defaults to false.

sessionId.description: Memory session ID you started and own.

status.description: How the session ended. failed still records what was learned.

summary.description: Durable summary of what the session established.

name: knowl_session_finish
